correctness.rationale: Every cell welfare function is a degree-n rational polynomial and an interior maximum is a root of its degree-(n-1) derivative. The log welfare is strictly concave and its central derivative changes from positive at 1/4 to negative at 3/4 for the prescribed two-cluster inputs. For a prime p=1 (mod n), distinct n-th roots modulo p give F'(Y)=nY^(n-1) (mod p); varying a single root modulo p^2 gives exact p-adic valuation one for the derivative constant coefficient because its e_(n-1) derivative is nonzero. Dirichlet supplies such p and rational grids hit arbitrary sub-boxes, Eisenstein gives irreducibility of degree n-1, and Rolle gives all simple real conjugates. Independent reconstructed four-agent cubic and its Eisenstein residue passed.
